raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 13 (ingested 2026-01-18) has customer_id values without zero padding ('C115', 'C91', 'C187' instead of 'C00115' and so on). That raises distinct customer_ids to 364, so those rows fail the inner join to silver_customers: 4600 − 4237 = 363 POSTED rows from batch 13 are dropped from gold_region_daily, and gold_customer_spend splits the same customers across two IDs. Re-padding the numeric part to 5 digits in silver_transactions restores the canonical key.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(customer_id, '^C[0-9]{1,5}$') THEN 'C' || lpad(substr(customer_id, 2), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
